# Clockify

> A simple and elegant clock with world clocks, an alarm, a stopwatch and a countdown. Everything runs in the browser; settings are encrypted on the device.

- [Clock](index.html): current time, digital or analog
- [World clocks](clocks.html): time in 53 countries
- [Alarm](alarm.html): alarm with six ringtones
- [Stopwatch](stopwatch.html): laps to the thousandth of a second
- [Countdown](countdown.html): up to 99 minutes
